# Philosophy Defined

Verified English philosophy quotations, thinker pages, theme hubs, and beginner guides.

https://www.philosophydef.com/

## When to use

Use this site when the job is to:

- look up a sourced English philosophy quotation (author, work, and archive ID)
- browse philosophy quotes about a feeling or theme (love, loneliness, self, death, knowledge)
- read a short guide such as what is philosophy, what is epistemology, or philosophy of AI
- compare Plato vs Aristotle or Confucianism vs Daoism at an introductory level
- cite a passage in APA, MLA, or Chicago from the quotation detail page

Do not treat this archive as a complete scholarly edition or a substitute for primary-language texts.

## How to use

Fetch HTML at https://www.philosophydef.com/{path} with no API key.

Markdown content negotiation: request any page with `Accept: text/markdown`
and the same URL returns a Markdown version of the page (Content-Type
text/markdown, Vary: Accept). Set the Accept header; do not guess .md URLs.
Browsers requesting text/html keep receiving HTML.

Machine-readable surfaces:

- llms-full.txt — the concept layer of the archive in one file
- /okf/index.md — Open Knowledge Format bundle (cross-linked concept files with YAML frontmatter)
- /data/quotes-archive.json — the full quotation corpus as JSON
- Sitemap: https://www.philosophydef.com/sitemap-index.xml

Useful entry points:

- Home (random quotation): https://www.philosophydef.com/
- Quote archive: https://www.philosophydef.com/quotes
- Famous quotes: https://www.philosophydef.com/quotes/famous
- Quote detail: https://www.philosophydef.com/quotes/q0001
- Thinkers: https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers
- Themes: https://www.philosophydef.com/themes
- Who said this quote (sourcing tool): https://www.philosophydef.com/quote-source
- Misattributed quotes: https://www.philosophydef.com/misattributed-quotes
- What is philosophy: https://www.philosophydef.com/what-is-philosophy
- Epistemology: https://www.philosophydef.com/what-is-epistemology
- Stoicism quotes: https://www.philosophydef.com/schools/stoicism
- Contact: https://www.philosophydef.com/contact

How to call a quotation page: GET https://www.philosophydef.com/quotes/{id} where {id} is lowercase, e.g. q0001.

How to call a thinker page: GET https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/{slug}

How to call a theme page: GET https://www.philosophydef.com/themes/{slug}
